stories.title: INTERVIEW - «Wenn die Schweiz nur noch Luxusuhren macht, reicht das wahrscheinlich nicht»

en.title: INTERVIEW - "If Switzerland only makes luxury watches, that probably won't be enough"
en.summary: Swiss watch exports are declining, creating challenges for suppliers. A Deloitte luxury goods specialist discusses why the Swiss watch industry's reliance on luxury production and the "Swiss made" label is no longer sufficient.

stories.title: Krieg in der Ukraine – Kiew arbeitet an besserer Abwehr russischer Jetdrohnen

en.title: War in Ukraine – Kyiv works on better defense against Russian jet-powered drones
en.summary: Kyiv is intensively developing defensive measures against jet-powered drones that have disrupted the city for weeks. Efforts to counter this threat are accelerating.

stories.title: Teures Benzin und Diesel – Rekordhohe Spritpreise: Wie Staaten gegensteuern

en.title: Expensive petrol and diesel - Record-high fuel prices: How states are countering
en.summary: Fuel prices have reached unprecedented levels worldwide. Governments are implementing various measures to help drivers cope with the high costs.

stories.title: Bundesrätlicher Pflichttermin – Bonjour Tristesse: Willkommen zur jährlichen Prämienexplosion

en.title: Federal council mandatory appointment - Bonjour Tristesse: Welcome to the annual premium explosion
en.summary: Health ministers annually announce rising health insurance premiums. The recurring announcement has become a predictable and unwelcome tradition.

stories.title: Tiefe Wasserpegel – Wassermangel in der Schweiz: «Es müsste jetzt monatelang regnen»

en.title: Low water levels - Water shortage in Switzerland: "It would need to rain for months"
en.summary: Switzerland is experiencing low water levels following a dry summer. A water researcher indicates the effects will persist well into the coming year.

stories.title: Les patrons de l'IA promettent de s'autoréguler et adoptent un code de bonne conduite

en.title: AI bosses promise self-regulation and adopt code of conduct
en.summary: Major AI sector leaders adopted a voluntary code of conduct on Monday amid growing concerns about artificial intelligence dangers. The declaration was made at the White House with approval from Donald Trump, who opposes mandatory regulation.

stories.title: Les patrons de l’IA adoptent un «code de bonne conduite» sous la houlette de Donald Trump

en.title: AI bosses adopt "code of conduct" under Donald Trump's leadership
en.summary: Anthropic, Google, Meta, Nvidia and Tesla committed to internal controls, external evaluations, and independent committees, though the voluntary code has no legal binding force. The initiative was endorsed by Trump, who opposes mandatory regulation of artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Une expulsion provoquée et un but d’entrée, la Suisse douche l’Ecosse à Glasgow

en.title: A provoked expulsion and an early goal, Switzerland douses Scotland at Glasgow
en.summary: Switzerland defeated Scotland 3:0 in a Nations League Group B match in Glasgow after Scotland was reduced to ten players early in the game. Goals came from Rodriguez, Elvedi, and Amdouni.

stories.title: Ligue des nations - La Suisse enchaîne en dominant l'Ecosse 3-0 à Glasgow

en.title: Nations League - Switzerland extends streak by dominating Scotland 3-0 in Glasgow
en.summary: Switzerland secured a second Nations League victory by beating Scotland 3-0 away in Glasgow. Goals were scored by Ricardo Rodriguez, Nico Elvedi, and Zeki Amdouni.

stories.title: Notre graphique: voici la hausse des primes maladie, assureur par assureur

en.title: Our chart: here is the increase in health insurance premiums, insurer by insurer
en.summary: Swiss health insurance premiums are rising 5% on average in 2027, but increases vary significantly between insurers. Price differences between insurance companies across French-speaking Switzerland have a larger impact on costs than the highest increases from individual insurers.

stories.title: Primes d’assurance maladie en hausse: Berne renvoie la balle aux acteurs de la santé

en.title: Health insurance premiums rising: Bern passes the buck to healthcare actors
en.summary: Facing a 5% increase in health insurance premiums, the Swiss federal government says it has launched necessary reforms and calls on healthcare providers to take responsibility. Federal health counselor Elisabeth Baume-Schneider stated tools exist to reduce healthcare costs.

stories.title: Les assurés sont "pris à la gorge": les réactions fusent après l'annonce de la hausse des primes maladie

en.title: Insured are "squeezed": reactions pour in after health insurance premium increase announcement
en.summary: The latest health insurance premium increase draws universal opposition, though solutions are debated. Doctors, hospitals, insurers, political parties, and unions all called for measures, divided between reducing unnecessary services and revising financing systems.

stories.title: Teures Gas und Erdöl: Die EU bereitet sich auf einen «sehr harten Winter» vor, sagt der EU-Kommissar

en.title: Expensive gas and oil: EU prepares for a "very harsh winter", says EU commissioner
en.summary: Europe faces financial pressure as gas storage must be filled at considerable cost. Consumers will feel the impact as governments lack funds for relief measures, the result of inadequate preparatory steps taken in spring.

stories.title: «Protektion, Bürokratie, Planung statt Wettbewerb»: Ein neues EU-Gesetz führt bei Deutschlands Wirtschaftsverbänden zu heftigen Diskussionen

en.title: "Protection, Bureaucracy, Planning Instead of Competition": A New EU Law Sparks Heated Debate Among German Business Associations
en.summary: A new EU law would require governments to favor European products in certain procurement processes, causing division within industry over concerns about potential Chinese countermeasures.

stories.title: Löschen Chatbots die Menschheit aus? Der Chef von Europas grösster KI-Hoffnung hält diese Erzählung für ein Ablenkungsmanöver der Amerikaner

en.title: Do Chatbots Wipe Out Humanity? The CEO of Europe's Biggest AI Hope Calls This Narrative an American Distraction
en.summary: French AI startup Mistral opened its first German office in Munich, with CEO Arthur Mensch arguing that existential AI risks are overstated and that Europeans face more pressing concerns.

stories.title: Nach dem Gipfel von Trump und Xi: Der Iran-Krieg offenbart Amerikas militärische Schwäche, und China schaut genau hin

en.title: After Trump and Xi's Summit: The Iran War Reveals America's Military Weakness, and China is Watching Closely
en.summary: The U.S. is depleting weapons stockpiles in the Middle East while China simultaneously builds military capabilities in the Pacific and controls supply chains vital for American weapons replenishment.
